title: Webhook delivery
description: The body of the POST the Link's webhook Send Adapter makes for each Send (protocol/spec/send-bundles.md §6). Headers: content-type application/json; reflex-delivery <space>/<send> (the same on every try); reflex-attempt 1..3; reflex-timestamp <ms since the epoch>; reflex-signature v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<timestamp>.<body>")>. A 2xx answer acknowledges the delivery.

delivery.description: <space>/<send>, the same on every try, so a receiver drops repeats.

bundle.description: The Send Bundle, as wait_for_user returns it, except that each images[i] also has mime and base64 data. Validated against send-bundle.schema.json.
